notes.title: Release is coming earlier!
notes.notes:
Official game release date changed:
21 Ott 2016 @ 3:00am PDT
21 Ott 2016 @ 10:00am UTC

Why that?
Well, I fixed all the known issues and I need your feedbacks! :D
The game will come out at his 1.2.1 version, you will find all the details and release notes in-game in the News section.
